textTemplates.name: body
textTemplates.text:
Dear {!$Record.Opportunity_Owner__c},

Finance Team has approved / manually created the Proforma Invoice pertaining to the said opportunity(s).

Please find below the Invoice Details:

Invoice Name Customer Name Total Invoice VoD
{!$Record.Name} {!$Record.Customer_Name__c} {!totalVoD}

If a Proforma Invoice is unnecessary, kindly deselect the "Proforma Invoice required" option within the Opportunity.

If a Proforma Invoice is needed, kindly confirm the name of the client to whom the invoice should be addressed. Opportunity Level Details are as follows:

Opportunity Name Opportunity Link Client Name Client Email Client Mail Address (To) Client Mail Address (CC)
{!$Record.Opportunity_Name__r.Name} View Opportunity {!$Record.Customer_Name__c} {!$Record.Contact_Name__r.Email} {!$Record.Client_Mail_Address_To__c} {!$Record.Client_Mail_Address_CC__c}

If the client information is verified as accurate, kindly mark the 'Client Name Correct' checkbox within the Opportunity.

Please review and update the client details in the opportunity if any information is inaccurate.

Thank you,
ICRA Limited

textTemplates.name: body_Rejected
textTemplates.text:
Dear {!$Record.Opportunity_Owner__c},

The Finance Team has rejected the following surveillance opportunity for the following reason:

{!Get_ProcessInstanceStep.Comments}
Opportunity Name (link) Billing Start Date
{!$Record.Opportunity_Name__r.Name} {!$Record.Opportunity_Name__r.Billing_Start_Date__c}

However, if a Proforma Invoice is unnecessary, kindly deselect the "Proforma Invoice required" option within the Opportunity.

If a Proforma Invoice is needed, kindly confirm the name of the client to whom the invoice should be addressed. Opportunity Level Details are as follows:

Opportunity Name Opportunity Link Client Name Client Email Client Mail Address (To) Client Mail Address (CC)
{!$Record.Opportunity_Name__r.Name} View Opportunity {!$Record.Customer_Name__c} {!$Record.Contact_Name__r.Email} {!$Record.Client_Mail_Address_To__c} {!$Record.Client_Mail_Address_CC__c}

If the client information is verified as accurate, kindly mark the 'Client Name Correct' checkbox within the Opportunity.

Please review and update the client details in the opportunity if any information is inaccurate.

Additionally, please address the feedback provided by the Finance team and notify them by selecting the ‘Send to Finance’ button.

Thank you,
ICRA Limited
